data.name: Language
data.comment: Label of the choice of language for the app, at the top of the Look section.

data.name: LanguageRestartHint
data.value: Changing the language restarts the app.

data.name: HelpTranslate
data.comment: Link to a guide for people who want to translate the app.

data.comment: Label of the choice between light and dark colours.

data.name: ThemeDark
data.comment: Theme choice.

data.name: PhotoReminder
data.comment: Switch in Settings.

data.name: PhotoReminderHint
data.value: Once a month, Today lists what hasn't had a photo yet that month.
data.comment: Small text under the switch. Today is the name of the Today page.

data.name: WateringReminder
data.comment: Switch in Settings.

data.name: WateringReminderHint
data.value: Learns how often each plant gets water and asks you to check it when it's probably dry. It says nothing about a plant until it has seen a few waterings.
data.comment: Small text under the switch.

data.name: EmptyOuterPot
data.value: Remind me to empty the outer pot
data.comment: Checkbox in Settings.

data.name: EmptyOuterPotAfter
data.comment: Before a choice of how long to wait, like after 30 minutes.

data.name: Minutes15
data.comment: A time to wait, in a list.

data.name: Minutes30
data.comment: A time to wait, in a list.

data.name: Hours1
data.comment: A time to wait, in a list.

data.name: Hours2
data.comment: A time to wait, in a list.

data.name: Hours3
data.comment: A time to wait, in a list.

data.name: EmptyOuterPotHint
data.value: After you water a plant that stands in an outer pot, Today asks you to tip out the water that drained into it. Plants whose outer pot holds water on purpose are left out.
data.comment: Small text under the checkbox. Today is the name of the Today page.

data.name: KindsOfCare
data.comment: Link to the page where you add your own kinds of care.

data.name: KindsOfCareNone
data.value: Add your own, like misted or bottom watered
data.comment: Line under the link when there are none yet.

data.name: KindsOfCareCount
data.comment: Line under the link. {0} is how many kinds you added.

data.name: CareIntervals
data.comment: Link to the page where you set how often something comes back on Today.

data.name: CareIntervalsNone
data.value: Feeding, repotting and the like, coming back on Today
data.comment: Line under the link when there are none yet. Today is the name of the Today page.

data.name: Interval_One
data.comment: A count of care intervals when there is exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: Interval_Other
data.comment: A count of care intervals when there is not exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: Away
data.comment: Link to the page where you say when you're away.

data.name: AwayDetail
data.value: Today stops asking while you're away or taking a break
data.comment: Line under the link. Today is the name of the Today page.

data.name: DailyRound
data.comment: Switch in Settings.

data.name: DailyRoundHint
data.value: Today suggests one room a day to go round.
data.comment: Small text under the switch. Today is the name of the Today page.

data.name: RoundDays
data.comment: Label over the weekdays you go round your plants, and a choice of days for notifications.

data.name: RoundDaysHint
data.value: Plants due for a check come up on your round day before, instead of each on its own day. A plant that dries out faster than the time between round days keeps its own days.
data.comment: Small text under the weekdays.

data.name: EverydayNames
data.comment: Label of the choice of language for the everyday names shown under a plant's botanical name.

data.name: EverydayEnglish
data.comment: Choice of language for everyday plant names.

data.name: EverydayDanish
data.comment: Choice of language for everyday plant names.

data.name: EverydayHint
data.value: A plant with no nickname shows what it's called under its botanical name, like {0} for {1}.
data.comment: Small text under the choice. {0} is an example everyday name and {1} is the botanical name in italics. Keep the {1}, it is the same in every language.

data.name: GooglePhotos
data.comment: Switch in Settings.

data.name: GooglePhotosHint
data.value: Adds a Google Photos choice next to the phone's gallery, for photos that are only in the cloud. Google asks you to allow it the first time, and again after an hour.
data.comment: Small text under the switch.

data.name: YourFields
data.comment: Link to the page where you add your own fields to plants.

data.name: YourFieldsNone
data.comment: Line under the link when there are none.

data.name: Field_One
data.comment: A count of your own fields when there is exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: Field_Other
data.comment: A count of your own fields when there is not exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: RecentChanges
data.comment: Label of a choice of how long a plant's page keeps saying what happened lately.

data.name: RecentChangesHint
data.value: Under a plant's name, what happened lately: when it arrived, was repotted or moved.
data.comment: Small text under the choice.

data.name: Week_One
data.comment: A number of weeks when there is exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: Week_Other
data.comment: A number of weeks when there is not exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: PotUpWarn
data.value: Say when a new pot is much bigger
data.comment: Label of a number field.

data.name: PotUpWarnBefore
data.comment: Before the number field, like more than 5 cm wider.

data.name: PotUpWarnAfter
data.comment: After the number field, like more than 5 cm wider.

data.name: PotUpWarnHint
data.value: When you pick a new pot for a plant or a cutting, a note says if it is this much wider across the top than the old one. A wide pot keeps the soil wet longer.
data.comment: Small text under the number field.

data.name: NotifyNeedsAccount
data.value: A daily list of what Today asks for. It needs an account, since the server sends it.
data.comment: Shown in Notifications when nobody is signed in. Today is the name of the Today page.

data.name: NotifyHomeScreen
data.value: On iPhone and iPad, add Stikling to your home screen first: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Open it from there and turn notifications on here.
data.comment: Shown in Notifications on an iPhone or iPad. Share and Add to Home Screen are buttons in the browser, use the words the device shows.

data.name: NotifyUnsupported
data.value: This browser can't show notifications from websites.
data.comment: Shown in Notifications.

data.name: NotifyNotYet
data.comment: Shown in Notifications.

data.name: NotifyIntro
data.value: One notification a day with what Today asks for, never a reminder to water. Each device is turned on by itself.
data.comment: Shown in Notifications before they are turned on. Today is the name of the Today page.

data.name: NotifyTurnOn
data.comment: Button that turns notifications on.

data.name: NotifyReady
data.comment: Shown after the first tap on Turn on. Turn on is the button, use the same words as the button.

data.name: NotifyBlockedTurnOn
data.value: Notifications are blocked for stikling.app in this browser. Allow them in the site settings (the icon next to the address), then tap Turn on again.
data.comment: Shown after trying to turn notifications on. Turn on is the button, use the same words as the button.

data.name: NotifyBlockedAlready
data.value: Notifications are blocked for stikling.app in this browser. Allow them in the site settings (the icon next to the address), then turn them off and on again here.
data.comment: Shown in Notifications when the browser blocks them.

data.name: NotifyFailed
data.value: Couldn't turn notifications on right now. Try again in a moment.
data.comment: Shown when turning notifications on failed.

data.name: NotifyTime
data.comment: Label of the time of day a notification is sent.

data.name: NotifyDays
data.comment: Label of the choice of which days a notification is sent.

data.name: NotifyEveryDay
data.comment: Choice of which days a notification is sent.

data.name: NotifyPickDays
data.comment: Choice of which days a notification is sent: the ones you pick.

data.name: NotifyDaysGroup
data.comment: Name of the weekday buttons, read out by a screen reader.

data.name: NotifyNoDayPicked
data.value: With no day picked, nothing is sent.
data.comment: Small text under the weekday buttons.

data.name: NotifyYourRoundDays
data.comment: Small text. {0} is a list of weekdays, like Mon, Thu.

data.name: NotifyOnHint
data.value: One notification a day with what Today asks for, never a reminder to water. The time and days are yours on every device. This device is on.
data.comment: Shown in Notifications once they are on. Today is the name of the Today page.

data.name: NotifySendTest
data.comment: Button that sends a test notification.

data.name: NotifyTurnOff
data.comment: Button that turns notifications off.

data.name: CleanWeeks
data.value: Clean before a case can be resolved
data.comment: Label of a choice of how many weeks. A case is a pest case.

data.name: CleanWeeksHint
data.value: A case being watched counts the days since its last treatment. Finding pests again starts the count over.
data.comment: Small text under the choice. A case is a pest case.

data.name: QuarantineLength
data.comment: Label of a choice of how many weeks.

data.name: QuarantineLengthHint
data.value: How long a plant is kept apart when it goes into quarantine. You can change it for each plant.
data.comment: Small text under the choice.

data.name: QuarantineNew
data.comment: Switch in Settings.

data.name: QuarantineNewHint
data.value: A plant you add that was bought, swapped or a gift starts in quarantine. You can untick it on the form.
data.comment: Small text under the switch.

data.name: RoomsAndTags
data.comment: Link to the page for rooms and tags.

data.name: RoomsAndTagsNone
data.value: Rename or merge them everywhere at once
data.comment: Line under the link when there are no rooms or tags yet.

data.name: Room_One
data.comment: A count of rooms when there is exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: Room_Other
data.comment: A count of rooms when there is not exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: Tag_Other
data.comment: A count of tags when there is not exactly one. {0} is the number.

data.name: RoomsAndTagsBoth

data.name: CollectionNumbers
data.comment: Link and heading for numbering the plants you have.

data.name: CollectionNumbersDetail
data.value: Number the plants you have, oldest first.

data.name: NumberingHint

data.name: NumberThem
